title: Page 249
transc:
Rosecrans district which I find in consider able confusion
peru I can complete the retremplation of Rousseaus pontiac
I shall pro seed to bridle unless the quadroon
prefer I should remain here walrus lantern very busy
Eckert


Washington Oct 15 / 64
Dealy "F"
dont fail to be at wharf
when the man hattan arrives from
grapes with brutus on board dont
mention his coming to any one
presume Bates posted you fully etc
T. T. Eckert


Washington Oct 15 / 64
Geo D. Sheldon "J"
the secret airy of war Edwin 
M S. left Washington at noon
today for City point on board
the man hattan pause thought best
let you know as he might
call upon you he knows you
are working on Cable period he
will pass Jamestown Island early tomorrow
morning Dealy can post you etc
T. T. Eckert
